description: Sample and hold building staircase voltages out of whatever is patched into it, with a slew limiter on a second output

params.text: Attenuates the held voltage before it reaches both outputs, silent at 0 and full at 1.
Attenuates the voltage at the CV S input before it adds to the SAMPLE setting, 0 to 1.
Adds 5V to the sampled voltage in one position and passes it as sampled in the other.
Sets how fast the SLEW OUT voltage travels, from 10000V per second at 0 to 0.1V per second at 1.
Crossfades the slew between a constant rate and a rate proportional to the distance left to travel, which rounds the corners of the staircase.

inputs.text: A rising edge takes a new sample of the IN voltage and holds it until the next one.
The voltage that is sampled; with nothing patched here the SAMPLE knob's own value is sampled instead, so the randomness comes from what you patch in.
Slows the slew, adding a tenth of the SLEW knob's travel per volt.
Adds to the SAMPLE setting through the CV S knob, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt.

outputs.text: The voltage held since the last trigger, scaled by SAMPLE.
The held voltage with the slew limiter applied.

notes: a new module holds both outputs at 0V: the SAMPLE knob comes up at 0, which scales the held voltage to nothing, and no voltage is sampled until a clock reaches CLK.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the sample range knob plus its CV.
